title: Fit Race Game
description: Hey Gamers, lets play body fun race and make the body from fat to fit instantly and see the cool and funny body shapes by just collecting different amount of calories foods and see the impact instantly. But Its not just a fun body race, there are lot of body weight challenges, which you have to achieve by eating right food items, For instance, if you want to gain weight, you have to eat burgers, sandwiches, ice-cream and milk etc. and similarly eat cucumbers, tomatoes and broccoli to loss your weight. So, You have to choose your diet wisely to achieve your goal and win the level.
instructions: Mouse click or tap to play
